facts.fact: Tris 换回自己的状态、赤脚登上回博物馆的火车，说再也不穿 Erudite 的鞋
facts.anchor: When I board the train that will take me back to the Museum, I do it barefoot.

facts.fact: 车厢里灯没亮，她看见黑暗里的人影时胃一沉，据此认定同车者是 factionless
facts.anchor: My stomach lurches when I see the dark shapes

facts.fact: 眼睛适应黑暗后她认出坐在大木箱上、抱膝蜷着的是 Sly，旁边还有 Gretchen 和一个她不认识的 Fox
facts.anchor: Sitting on top of a big crate, hunched over her knees, is Sly.

facts.fact: Sly 说箱子里是某种设备，要送去给 Makers，而 Makers 在博物馆里作业
facts.anchor: Some kind of equipment. We’re taking it to the Makers.

facts.fact: Christina（绰号 Eye Patch）准时返回，整整一小时待在庭院花园，没人跟她说话
facts.anchor: Apparently she spent her entire hour in some kind of courtyard garden and no one even spoke to her.

facts.fact: Sly 纠正入口的白花不是 Queen Anne’s lace，而是剧毒的 hemlock
她事后回铁轨捡起那个掉落的小东西，借月光判断那可能是一颗子弹（她从没见过实物）
见过 Eric 拿枪之后在她心里鼓起来的那点希望，因为这颗子弹泄了气
facts.anchor: Whatever hope was ballooning inside me after I saw Eric with the gun . . . deflates.
